notes.title: ---DEFINITIVE UPDATE---
notes.content:
The End is here!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/gDUI4Ujl.png[/img]

Galactic Counselors is hereby completed, and no further updates are to be expected. If need arises and bugs or other issues are found, patches can be made.

The Definitive Update brings all this to the game:
[list]
[*]ENDGAME EVENT: You can toggle it on or off prior to starting a campaign. At turn 30, a special event will start which will spell doom to any careless factions, as the Sun is dying out...
[*]new unit: Armageddon Fanatic is a unique new footsoldier available to all factions during the new endgame event.
[*]turn counter added
[*]battles can be sped-up even faster 
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/vfj2Thkl.png[/img]
